name: Collection Centre Operations
description: Diagnostic franchise SaaS platform with multi-centre onboarding, role-based access control (RBAC) inside collection centres, separate authorized login portals, patient registry, test catalog, billing, prepaid wallet ledger, smart QR/barcode tube tracking, phlebotomy verification, courier dispatch, and Central Reference Laboratory accession test data extraction (CSV, HL7 JSON, Handover Manifest).
